data.one_liner: Generate lexicographical sort strings for efficient list item reordering.
data.what_it_does: Easily generates lexicographical ranks between two existing ranks for reordering list items. It also provides methods to generate a list of initial ranks and check if ranks exceed a threshold.
use_when: You need to implement drag-and-drop list reordering without updating indices of all items.
You want to generate initial lists of lexicographical ranks.
avoid_when: You do not need lexicographical sorting for your lists.
strengths: Provides helper methods for generating ranks between two values.
Can generate initial ranks for bulk items.
Includes a threshold check for re-balancing.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on edge cases beyond basic examples.
